include_once comm_PerDefinition.txt

platform_type GROUND_JAMMER_STATION WSF_PLATFORM
  radar_signature COMMAND_VEHICLE_SIG
  mover WSF_SURFACE_MOVER
    update_interval 1 sec
  end_mover
  sensor detection_radar WSF_RADAR_SENSOR
    mode default
      frame_time 5 sec
      beam 1
        azimuth_field_of_view -180 deg 180 deg
        elevation_field_of_view -10 deg 10 deg
        minimum_range 1 km
        maximum_range 55560 m
        transmitter
          frequency 2.4 GHz
          power 1000 W
        end_transmitter
        receiver
          noise_figure 3 dB
          bandwidth 1 MHz
        end_receiver
      end_beam
      reports_location
      reports_velocity
      reports_bearing
    end_mode
    on
  end_sensor



  processor auto_jammer_proc WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR
  end_processor
  processor script_proc WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR
  end_processor
end_platform_type

platform_type AIRBORNE_JAMMER_PLATFORM WSF_PLATFORM
  radar_signature DRONE_SIG
  mover WSF_AIR_MOVER
    update_interval 1 sec
  end_mover
  sensor detection_radar WSF_RADAR_SENSOR
    mode default
      frame_time 5 sec
      beam 1
        azimuth_field_of_view -180 deg 180 deg
        elevation_field_of_view -10 deg 10 deg
        minimum_range 1 km
        maximum_range 55560 m
        transmitter
          frequency 2.4 GHz
          power 1000 W
        end_transmitter
        receiver
          noise_figure 3 dB
          bandwidth 1 MHz
        end_receiver
      end_beam
      reports_location
      reports_velocity
      reports_bearing
    end_mode
    on
  end_sensor
  weapon alq99_jammer WSF_RF_JAMMER
    on
    mode_template
      transmitter
        frequency 2.4 GHz
        bandwidth 20 MHz
        power 100 W
        antenna_pattern OMNI_ANTENNA_HIGHGAIN
      end_transmitter
    end_mode_template
    mode broadband_jamming
    end_mode
    mode spot_jamming
    end_mode
    mode sweep_jamming
    end_mode
    mode default
    end_mode
  end_weapon
  processor script_proc WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR
  end_processor
end_platform_type
